units.source_text: 我害怕一個人靜靜地待在租屋的房間裡，總覺得會被誰突然襲擊一下，

en.t: I was afraid to sit quietly alone in my rented room, always feeling as if someone might suddenly attack me,

units.source_text: 於是跑到大街上，要麼去協助地下運動，要麼和堀木一起到處去喝廉價酒，學業和繪畫全都荒廢了。

en.t: so I would run out into the streets, either helping with the underground movement or going around drinking cheap liquor with Horiki, until both my studies and my painting were completely neglected.

units.source_text: 在進入高中第二年的十一月，發生了我和一名有夫之婦殉情的事件，從此我的人生境遇完全改變。

en.t: In November of my second year after entering high school, there occurred the incident in which I attempted a lovers' suicide with a married woman, and from then on the circumstances of my life changed completely.

units.source_text: 上學經常曠課，學習也從不用功，

en.t: I was often absent from school and never applied myself to my studies,

units.source_text: 但每次考試都深得考題要領，所以一直瞞過了家人。

en.t: but each time I took an examination I somehow grasped exactly what the questions required, and so I kept deceiving my family.

units.source_text: 可是，終因曠課太多，學校好像悄悄通報了老家的父親，

en.t: However, because I had finally missed too many classes, the school seems to have quietly informed my father back home,

units.source_text: 大哥替父親給我寫來了一封措辭嚴厲的長信。

en.t: and my eldest brother, writing on my father's behalf, sent me a long letter in stern language.
